theme_archetype: Archetype 5: Jewel & Luxury (Tech Precision Variant). The domain is high-end architecture and interior design in Ahmedabad. It requires a 'Billion-dollar startup' aesthetic. We will use a Dark Premium theme with gold/beige accents, blending cinematic lighting with Apple-like minimal clarity.

rules: No generic 'Inter' or 'Roboto' for headings. Use Outfit for a premium, geometric Apple-like feel.
Headlines must use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Never use text-7xl or above for Hero headings; fluid clamp to 6xl max.
Avoid centering text by default; left-align for modern editorial feel.

spacing_and_layout.generous_spacing: Use 2-3x typical spacing. Sections should have py-24 or py-32.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Use Mode A (Tetris Grid) for Portfolio: mix col-span-8 and col-span-4 to create asymmetry and visual tension.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Use Mode B (Control Room Grid) for Admin/User Dashboard with gap-6 and cardless flat surfaces.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Containers with borders MUST have padding (p-8) to prevent text collision.

surface_strategies.cards: Flat background (bg-[#121212]), 1px subtle border (border-[#262626]), no heavy dropshadows in dark mode.
surface_strategies.glassmorphism: For Sticky Nav/Header: bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and a delicate 1px border-b border-white/10.
surface_strategies.hero_overlay: Gradient overlay from black/80 via black/40 to transparent. Never use flat blanket overlays that kill image quality.
surface_strategies.buttons: Primary CTA: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black font-medium. Hover: bg-[#C5A059] transition-colors duration-300.

defaults.hover: Subtle scale up (scale-105) for images, opacity shifts for text.

component_strategies.landing_page: Custom HTML/Tailwind. Asymmetrical hero with floating gold accents. Use the generated abstract 3D bg for sections.
component_strategies.portfolio_gallery: Bento grid with hover-reveal details. Images must have max-h-[80vh] on mobile.
component_strategies.ai_designer_tool: Split screen or interactive slider (before/after). Use the provided AI Redesign graphic.
component_strategies.lead_generation: Shadcn UI forms, heavily customized with Dark/Gold theme. Flat inputs, 1px gold-tinted borders on focus.
component_strategies.dashboard: Shadcn UI components. Cardless or minimal cards. Dense data hierarchy. Sidebar navigation.

hero_backgrounds.description: Abstract high-end 3D geometric composition for hero section background

ai_feature.description: Wireframe to photorealistic modern living room transition for AI tool showcase

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this file completely before scaffolding the frontend.
Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body fonts. Add them via Google Fonts.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for Landing/Marketing sections. Use customized Shadcn for Dashboards/Forms.
All interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='book-consultation-btn').
Ensure dark mode is the default, with a toggle for light mode. Configure Tailwind config appropriately.
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance animations and hover transitions.
Do NOT use placeholder images. Use only the URLs provided in the image_urls section.
